title: Taiwan Curbs AI Chip Exports to China Under US Deal
summary:
Taiwan will categorize AI servers and advanced semiconductors as controlled items, making the shipment of restricted AI hardware to mainland China a criminal offense under the Foreign Trade Act. Economy Minister Gong Ming-xin told Bloomberg that the measures will be implemented as part of a trade agreement with the US to ensure Taiwan's regulations match those of the US government.

A senior official in Taipei said these controls join the Trump administration's effort to stop the smuggling of cutting-edge semiconductors into China. The rules target the hardware ecosystem required for high-end artificial intelligence, shifting Taipei's policy to further align with Washington's trade restrictions.

selectedTweets.bestBit: 向中国大陆运送受限人工智能硬件将触犯《对外贸易法》，构成刑事犯罪
selectedTweets.text:
彭博：作为与美国贸易协议的一部分，台湾将限制对华人工智能芯片出口。
据台北一位高级官员透露，台湾正准备收紧人工智能芯片的出口管制，以进一步与美国的限制保持一致，加入特朗普政府打击向中国走私尖端半导体的行列。
台湾经济部长龚明信告诉彭博社，台北计划将人工智能服务器和尖端半导体列入管制物品清单 。他表示，措施生效后，向中国大陆运送受限人工智能硬件将触犯《对外贸易法》，构成刑事犯罪。
